titles.title: As the Deer (Just as the Deer Pants)

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
My soul longs and even faints
For the courts of the Lord
Lord, my heart and my flesh cry out
For You, O God

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
You're my sun and my shield
You give grace and glory
No good thing will You withhold
From those who seek Your face

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Just as the deer pants for the water brook
So pants my soul for You, O God

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
I set my heart on a pilgrimage
Through the valley of weeping I will go
I set my heart on a pilgrimage
Until I appear before God in Zion

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
Be near, O God
Be near, O God of us
Your nearness is to us our good
